ISAACSCHWARTZ TERMINATIONOFMEMORANDUMOFCONTRACT This Termination of MEMORANDUM of Contract is dated as of January, 2024 between Usher Kupperman (collectively,“Seller"), having an address at 1857 60th St., 3B, Brooklyn, NY, 11204, and Isaac Schwartz and Raizy Schwartz (collectively, “Purchaser"), having an address at 1441 46 Street, Brooklyn, NY 11219. RECITALS: Reference is made to that certain Memorandum of Contract, (the “Memorandum of Contract"), wherein Seller agreed to sell toPurchaser, and Purchaser has agreed to purchase Unit No.3B ("Unit") in the building ("Building") known as The 60th Street Holdings Condominium ("Condominium") and located at 1857 60th St.,Brooklyn, NY,11204; Block: 05512; Lot: 1006; "), as more fully described on Exhibit“A”attached hereto,under the terms and conditions described in said Contract. Seller and Purchaser,in connection with their respective interests in and to the Memorandum of Contract, desire to terminate the Memorandum of Contract and the underlying Contract, and to deem them rendered it null and void ab initio. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of ten dollars and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency whereof is hereby acknowledged, Seller and Purchaser hereby agree as follows: 1. The Memorandum of Contract and underlying Contract are hereby terminated and is of no further force and effect. 2. The Memorandum of Contract and underlying Contract are rendered null and void ab initio, and all resulting interests of either party are negated and are further retroactively rendered invalid. 3.Purchaser and Seller hereby agree to cooperate with each other in executing or effectuating any documents as may be required to further demonstrate or substantiate the terms of this final and irrevocable Termination. The parties hereto hereby consent to the recordation of the Termination of Memorandum of Contract.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF,the parties have duly executed this Termination of Memorandum of Contract as of the_ day of January 2024.
